apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Husk 3.0
The coolest and biggest Husk release yet. Hundreds of new Android games, PS4 support, and more.

## What's new?
- Console-style home screen
- New library UI
- Proper first run
    - Contains full setup guide + optional walkthrough
### PS4 Games
- Add a game with the + button. Either a PKG, a folder of PKG's, or an extracted game folder. Updates install with their game.
- Tested: Bloodborne, Minecraft: PlayStation 4 Edition, Sonic Mania
- Shaders are kept inbetween launches with Shader Cache
- If a game requires keyboard input, it'll open the iOS keyboard
### Android
- 366 newly working games - view in compatibility list
- Unofficial ports: Sonic Robo Blast 2, Nethack, PokeWilds and more
- GoDot 4
- Store downloads include OBB files
- Typing works in all games
- Optional language fonts (chinese, japanese, etc)
### Also
- Lots of fixes
- TrollStore JIT fully complete
- iOS 15.5 support
## Known Issues
- Bloodborne runs, but very poorly.
- Some Unity 6 games can render slowly
## Final notes
Thank you all. Enjoy ❤️ 

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/xApMHWAzkh
